# Bundled Gnirehtet

This directory contains the Windows x64 Rust runtime from the official
Gnirehtet v2.5.1 release.

- Source: https://github.com/Genymobile/gnirehtet
- Release: https://github.com/Genymobile/gnirehtet/releases/tag/v2.5.1
- Asset: `gnirehtet-rust-win64-v2.5.1.zip`
- SHA-256: `7f5b1063e7895182aa60def1437e50363c3758144088dcd079037bb7c3c46a1c`
- License: Apache-2.0 (see `windows-x64/LICENSE`)

The application uses `windows-x64/gnirehtet.exe` automatically when the
Gnirehtet setting is left at its default value. A user-specified executable
path remains supported as an override.
